text: Old electric school bell ringing loudly in a long school corridor, metallic continuous ring, then stops
School corridor right after the bell: many children running, sneakers squeaking, backpacks, excited voices in the distance, no clear words
Hurried adult footsteps in leather shoes on a polished school corridor floor, fast walking
Two people bump into each other and fall on a wooden floor, soft body thud, a big stack of paper sheets bursts and scatters with loud rustling
Many loose paper sheets gently fluttering and landing on a floor, soft rustle
A child quickly gets up and runs away down a corridor in sneakers
Wooden classroom door closing with a soft click, school corridor
Calm slow adult footsteps in leather shoes approaching on a polished floor, then stop
Hands gathering and stacking paper sheets on a floor, rustling paper
Quiet empty school corridor room tone, faint distant classroom murmur behind closed doors, soft air
Large paper sheet flying past the camera, airy paper whoosh
Dramatic slow motion burst of many paper sheets exploding into the air, deep soft whoosh with rustle
Soft warm ambient pad, gentle and hopeful, slow, no melody, no drums, cinematic underscore
